infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SpeedGun needs access to your photo library to select pitch videos for analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SpeedGun saves analysed pitch videos with overlays back to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SpeedGun uses the camera to record pitch videos for speed and pitch-type analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SpeedGun records audio with each pitch video to detect catch impact for accurate flight time.
